description: Named plugin bundles for /plugin install. Resolves the lack of native cross-plugin dependency declaration in Claude Code by letting the install-bundle slash command install a curated set in one shot.

bundles.name: xl-skills-full
bundles.description: Recommended. All plugins for the full skill-creator → prompt-creator → governance → distribution pipeline, plus end-user productivity plugins (contract-generator, mf-kessai-invoice-check) and the company-master enrichment plugin.

bundles.name: xl-skills-minimal
bundles.description: Just enough to author skills: skill-creator + prompt-creator. No governance, no intake, no Notion publishing.

bundles.name: xl-skills-intake
bundles.description: Non-engineer elicitation flow + Notion publishing. Includes skill-creator so generated briefs can flow through.
